svg.desc: Pale Light Promotions presents: / CARVER & THE FLOOD / with support from Mena Grace / Friday 19th September, doors 7:30pm / The Anchor Rooms, 14 Tallow Lane, Bristol WX4 2JQ / Tickets: £12 advance / £15 on the door / Available from The Anchor Rooms bar or pallightpro.co.uk / All ages.
